verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms TrueLayer serves an llms.txt at docs.truelayer.com (HTTP 200). It states that appending .md to any documentation page URL returns a markdown version, and many doc citations resolve to those .md pages, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or dedicated agent-usage guidance, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes all returned 404)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.truelayer.com/llms.txt # TrueLayer Documentation
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown versi
